exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage of pull:
  -concurrency int
    	blobs transferred at once (0: 64)
  -dmtcp-dir string
    	directory of DMTCP's programs, for the dmtcp backend (default "/opt/warmctl/dmtcp/bin")
  -docker string
    	Docker socket (default "/var/run/docker.sock")
  -mode string
    	where the snapshot will restore, as up's --mode: of an index's entries, one this host can restore that way (auto, host or in-place) (default "auto")
  -output string
    	snapshot directory to create (default: <state>/pulled/<digest>)
  -plain-http
    	talk to the registry over plain HTTP
  -state-dir string
    	state directory (blob store) (default "/var/lib/warmctl")
error: flag: help requested
